verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say every meeting automatically gets a clear summary, AI action items, decisions and topic-based minutes, which covers the structured key points, decisions and next steps. Two parts of the story are not evidenced: how soon after the meeting the summary arrives, and whether it is polished enough to share without editing. The webhook docs mention an 'AI note being generated' event but give no timing, and there is no hands-on or independent evidence of summary quality. Missing for 10: documented delivery timing right after the meeting, evidence the summaries are shareable without editing, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
When an event happens (like an AI note being generated or an action item being completed), Fellow sends an HTTP POST request to the URL you specify with details about the event.
